q: In Budgetary terms, what is "Budget Deficit"?
options: Excess of Revenue Expenditure over Revenue Receipts
Excess of All Expenditure over Revenue Receipts
Excess of All Expenditure over All Receipts
key_text: Excess of All Expenditure over All Receipts
explanation: The budget (budgetary) deficit is total expenditure minus total receipts – all revenue and capital receipts; expenditure over revenue receipts only is not it, and revenue expenditure over revenue receipts is the revenue deficit.

notes.text: - **Budget (budgetary) deficit** = **total expenditure − total receipts** (all receipts, revenue + capital); discontinued from **1996-97**.
